entries.description: Avuz Theme app: event listeners for login page and user creation, custom Deck welcome board, custom email template with Avuz logo
entries.notes: Fully custom app, no upstream counterpart. EMailTemplate extends OC\Mail\EMailTemplate — check if parent class API changed in v33.

entries.description: CSS: split-screen login, dashboard card styling, header gradient/logo centering, icon colors, settings text overflow fix
entries.notes: CSS selectors target upstream DOM classes. If Nextcloud changes class names or HTML structure in v33, these may silently break without merge conflicts.

entries.description: JS: Lucide icon library, dynamic favicon per-app, header centering script
entries.notes: lucide-icons.js wraps history.pushState and references /themes/avuz/apps/*/img/ paths. center-header.js targets #header DOM structure.

entries.description: Brand assets: logos for login/email, network diagram for split-screen, favicons
entries.notes: Binary files, no conflict risk.

entries.description: Lucide-style SVG icon overrides for navigation menu (light + dark variants) and spreed dashboard PNGs
entries.notes: Uses Nextcloud theme layer. Risk only if upstream renames icon filenames (e.g. deck.svg -> app.svg).

entries.description: Favicon overrides via Nextcloud theme layer
entries.notes: Binary/SVG files in theme directory. No conflict risk unless favicon naming changes.

entries.description: Icon overrides for App Store apps (deck, forms) installed to custom_apps/
entries.notes: Duplicates of themes/avuz/apps/ icons, needed because App Store apps live in custom_apps/ at runtime.

entries.description: Files -> Drive rename (1 key)
entries.notes: Single key override. Check if upstream changed the source string 'Files' in v33.

entries.description: Deck -> Tarefas rename + 416 activity log translations for board/card/list operations
entries.notes: Large translation set. Deck v33 may add/remove/rename activity strings. The overrides.json contains 15 key overrides merged at build time.

entries.description: Core branding: 6 keys replacing 'Nextcloud' with 'Avuz Conecta' in login/instance text
entries.notes: Core strings may change between releases. merge-l10n.sh handles merging, but source strings must still match.

entries.description: Settings app: 20 keys replacing Nextcloud references with Avuz Conecta
entries.notes: Settings strings change frequently between releases. Check for renamed/removed keys.

entries.description: Notifications: 53 keys for push/email/sound settings + 1 override for Talk call sound
entries.notes: Notifications is a git-installed app (not bundled). Check if v33 branch exists for notifications repo.

entries.description: Dashboard: 2 keys replacing Nextcloud with Avuz Conecta in intro text
entries.notes: Minimal override, unlikely to conflict.

entries.description: Federated sharing: 5 keys total for sharing UI text with Avuz branding
entries.notes: Minimal overrides.

entries.description: Hides WebDAV settings section from Files app settings dialog
entries.notes: Direct modification of upstream Vue component. Renamed from Settings.vue in v33. The patch comments out the WebDAV import and template usage.

entries.description: Rebuilt dist bundles from Settings.vue patch
entries.notes: Generated files. Will conflict on every upgrade. Should be rebuilt via 'npm run build' after rebase, not carried forward. Consider adding dist/ to .gitignore.

entries.description: Two-stage Docker build: base image (PHP/nginx/supervisor/redis) + app image (source + deps + build)
entries.notes: Custom files. Dockerfile copies avuz_theme assets and runs merge-l10n.sh at build time. Update any version-specific references (stable32) on upgrade.

entries.description: Container runtime: entrypoint (install/upgrade/configure NC), nginx (webserver), supervisor (process manager), cron
entries.notes: entrypoint.sh has GIT_APPS_BRANCH defaulting to stable32 — must update to stable33. Also hardcodes viewer app download from stable32.tar.gz.

entries.description: Compose files for local dev and Portainer staging deployment
entries.notes: Custom files, no upstream counterpart.

entries.description: Build scripts: base image, app image push, translation merging, translation update from upstream
entries.notes: Version-agnostic scripts. merge-l10n.sh is critical for translation overrides.

entries.description: Git and Docker ignore rules, git attributes for line endings
entries.notes: May have trivial conflicts if upstream also modifies .gitignore.

entries.description: Project context documentation for Claude Code
entries.notes: Custom file, no upstream counterpart.
